data.one_liner: A plugin implementing the WebAuthn authenticator model for generating Public Key Credentials
data.what_it_does: Implements the WebAuthn Authenticator model allowing Flutter apps to generate public key credentials, register users using biometrics, and create assertions for login. It uses local_auth and flutter_secure_storage under the hood.
use_when: You need to implement WebAuthn authenticator functionality in a Flutter application.
You want to use platform-supported biometrics and secure credential storage for WebAuthn authentication.
avoid_when: You do not require WebAuthn or platform authenticator capabilities.
Your Android minSdkVersion is lower than 18.
strengths: Implements the WebAuthn Authenticator model with helper methods for Web APIs.
weaknesses: Credential selection during assertions is not yet fully implemented (uses the most recently created credential).
StrongBox keystore is not fully supported across all Android devices.
data.setup_notes: Requires local_auth integration setup for iOS and Android. In build.gradle, minSdkVersion must be set to >= 18 for flutter_secure_storage. Uses build_runner for code generation.
